notes: Oorth: tall, still and hooded telepaths (standard rig). Deep indigo mantle and a pointed hood, narrow shoulders, a long robe with a flared train that sways with the walk (it lives in the legs layer) and long bell sleeves; only a toe tip shows when they step. Lilac-grey skin, long fingers, a bone ridge on the brow with the third eye set in it: head_glow has 2 pulse frames per variant (alternate at ~2 fps). Head variants: hood (default), bare (the hood pushed back), helmet (a pressure hood with a visor). Outfit mask = the robe and train, the sleeves, the stole and the shoulder bands. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 2 fps
